note: Madrasah Al Furqan, rendered by madrasah.html. Written by hand. PLACEHOLDERS: as of 7 October 2026 only two things here come from the madrasah: classes run six days a week with no classes on Friday, and there are two age groups, 6 and over and 12 and over. Every time, term date, summary and the places line is a placeholder, agreed so the page could be designed and reviewed. Anything marked "placeholder": true shows a 'To be confirmed' label on the page. When the madrasah confirms an item, correct it and delete its placeholder flag. When nothing is left to confirm, set "provisional" to false and the page drops its draft notice. scripts/check_madrasah.py lists whatever is still a placeholder.
